messages:
Pagerbot: PagerDuty page fired • service: inference-queue • urgency: high • incident: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/P123456 • auto-escalation in 2m if unacked.

Alex: Acked and taking. I'm oncall for this window. Pulling up queue metrics now. @Sam @Lee please stand by for quick mitigation options.

Sam: Seeing a 5xx spike coming from embedder-proxy (eu-west). Starting temporary scale for the dedicated pool. Running: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://infra-api/internal/scale -d '{"pool":"dedicated-embed-eu","delta":2}'
```
ETA ~90s for nodes to join.

Lee: Rate limiter shows a few tenants spiking to 300r/s. Will flip emergency per-customer cap to 10r/s for noisy tenants. Applying emergency config now: 
```bash
kubectl apply -f emergency-rate-limiter.yaml
```

Nancy: Noted customer impact: two customers reported timeouts via support queue. Escalating to CS and sending the mitigation template.

Ops-bot: Autoscaler accepted the scale request: provisioning 2 x g5 nodes (request id sc-9876). Estimated ready in ~75s.

Alex: Good. React :thumbsup: If latency doesn't improve in 3m, plan B is to route high-throughput customers to fallback model variant 'embed-small-v2' to keep tail down.

Sam: Scale completed, new nodes registered. Seeing initial token-level improvement; p50 improved but tail still high. Initiating selective fallback routing for top-3 noisy customers now.

Lee: Routing patch applied, tenants a12, b34, c56 moved to embed-small-v2. Confirmed reduced request rate to the primary pool.

Alex: Monitoring dashboards — thanks. Nancy, please send a short customer update that we mitigated with temporary throttles and model fallbacks; CS to follow with timeline.

Sam: p95 latency falling ~40% vs peak. Continuing to observe for 10m before rolling caps back.

Lee: Removing emergency per-customer caps gradually.

Nancy: CS update sent to affected customers; included note we'll do a follow-up RCA.

Alex: Looks stable. Marking incident acknowledged -> resolved in PagerDuty. Filing a postmortem request (assign to eng-runtime + eng-sre). Thanks all for the quick sync :party: 

Pagerbot: Incident P123456 closed by Alex.
